# upsnap_devices (Data Source)

List devices, optionally filtered. All filters are combined with AND.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "upsnap_devices" "online_lab" {
  status = "online"
  filter = "ip ~ \"192.168.10.\""
}

output "online_lab_devices" {
  value = data.upsnap_devices.online_lab.devices[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Raw [PocketBase filter](https://pocketbase.io/docs/api-records/#listsearch-records), for example `ip ~ "192.168.1."`.
- `group_id` (String) Only devices in this group.
- `name` (String) Only devices with exactly this name.
- `status` (String) Only devices in this state: `online`, `offline` or `pending`.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) Matching devices, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `created_by` (String) Owning user ID, empty for superuser-created devices.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `group_ids` (Set of String) Group IDs.
- `id` (String) Record ID.
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address or host name.
- `link` (String) Link URL.
- `mac` (String) MAC address.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `netmask` (String) Subnet mask.
- `port_ids` (Set of String) Port IDs.
- `shutdown_cron_enabled` (Boolean) Whether scheduled shutdown is enabled.
- `status` (String) Last known power state: `online`, `offline`, `pending`, or empty before the first ping.
- `wake_cron_enabled` (Boolean) Whether scheduled wake is enabled.
